to jericho 1.title: Fields
to jericho 1.text:
You are following Lucid's map to Jericho.

You walk across a vast open field of grass.
The open field concaves down, and you see across the field a massive crack in the ground blocking your way.

Cheese: [So we need to cross this canyon to get to Jericho?]

On the other side of the crack the grass fields are much more vibrant in color. The grass is greener on the other side!

Cheese: [Woo!]

Cheese enters ghost form and floats over the canyon towards the other side.
In the middle of flight he changes direction and comes back.

Cheese: [Wow, the canyon is way wider than it looks. It's kind of scary to float across.]

You look to the sides and find that the canyon stretches from horizon to horizon.
It's strange, since this canyon is not found on the map that Lucid gave you.

field 1.title: Fields
field 1.text:
You travel parallel to the canyon in hopes of finding a way around it.
You travel for the whole day and see the canyon still stretched across the horizon.

Cheese: [We should just go down and across. I can scout for you, you know?]

canyon 1.title: Canyon
canyon 1.text:
You follow a narrow path leading down the canyon, trailing through strange dark green foliage growing on the cliff walls.

Cheese: [Wew, I just went way down to see how far this goes, and it's pitch black all the way down.]

It is getting dark, and you decide to set up camp here and decide whether or not to climb back up tomorrow.

canyon 2.title: Canyon
canyon 2.text:
You hear some faint whirring noise and wake up.
It is still late night.
You look out the cliff and see orange light in the distance.
You look carefully, and it looks like someone had started a fire on a bush, and has gotten into a fight with a bunch of strange things.
There is also someone lying on the ground ahead of him.
You wake Cheese up.

Cheese: [Orange light? That way? Ok.]

Cheese floats toward where the light was in ghost form, swaying side to side because he's still half asleep.
You pack up all your stuff and wait for Cheese to come back...

canyon 3.title: Canyon
canyon 3.text:
It's now bright above the canyon, yet Cheese still hasn't returned.
You decide to walk further down the canyon toward the light to find Cheese.

The narrow path down the canyon is ever so dangerous, and you try your hardest to keep steady... Until a vine grasps your foot.

canyon 4.title: Canyon
canyon 4.text:
You barely destroy the vine without falling over.
You continue down the path, sometimes jumping and rock climbing to get down.
It's going to be hard to get back up.

---

You hike for an hour, yelling for Cheese once in a while.

You hear the familiar whirring sound from the darkness ahead of you.

canyon 5.title: Canyon
canyon 5.text:
As you descend down further, it gets harder to see where you are going.
Maybe coming down here was a bad idea...

You arrive at a flatter surface with more room to walk.
You walk a bit further down, and now whirring sounds echo from all around you... and they're getting closer.

opt.text: Light the surroundings with a fire
Take out your glowshroom bundle to light the way

canyon 6-4.title: Canyon
canyon 6-4.text:
You take out your glowshroom bundle to light the way.
The glowshroom light reveal dozens and dozens of the dreadful vines all around you!

canyon 6-3.title: Canyon
canyon 6-3.text: You keep running down the canyon into the darkness, but the whirring sounds only get louder. Just how many of those things are down here?

canyon 6-2.title: Canyon
canyon 6-2.text:
You quickly get your campfire kit out and light the nearest bush.

The newly lit light reveals the corpse of Cheese in front of you, lying face up and lifeless...

You stumble backward.
Dozens and dozens of vines emerge from the darkness and approach you...

canyon 6-1.title: Canyon
canyon 6-1.text:
Cheese: [H... Help!]

You immediately run toward's Cheese's voice and find him in the darkness.
You haul his blood soaked body by your shoulder and make a run for it.

Just as you try to climb back up the way you came from, a giant mass of vines grab you from behind.

chasm 2.title: Abyss
chasm 2.text:
...

You feel your face against warm sand.
You open your eyes.
It's pitch black.
You turn your head up and see the white crevice of daylight far, far above you. Is this the end?
Every bone in your body aches.

You walk the pitch black darkness hopelessly for a bit before giving up and lie down on the warm sands.

How much time has passed? The white crevice has faded into pitch black abyss.

chasm 3.title: Abyss
chasm 3.text:
You yell.
Whatever attention you gather seems like the least of your problems now.

But there are no responses whatsoever.

...

You start singing a steady chant in the darkness to alleviate your boredom and sense of doom.

chasm 4.title: Abyss
chasm 4.text:
You hear footsteps on the sand.
You stop singing.
You hear a soft thud.
You freeze in place. What monstrosity could take residence in this abyss?

chasm 5-1.title: Abyss
chasm 5-1.text:
???: [Take the amulet.]

A familiar yet strange voice reaches out to you from the darkness.

chasm 5-2.title: Abyss
chasm 5-2.text:
???: [Take the amulet... Wait, you already have it...?]

A familiar yet strange voice reaches out to you from the darkness. It sounds a little confused.

chasm 6-1.title: Abyss
chasm 6-1.text:
No response.
You walk toward where the sound came from and find what feels like an amulet on the ground.

You pick it up and press on it.

chasm 6-2.title: Abyss
chasm 6-2.text:
No response.
You walk toward where the sound came from but find nothing.
For some reason, this places feels familiar... You take out your amulet and subconsciously press it.

again to jericho 1.title: Fields
again to jericho 1.text:
For some reason, it feels like you'ved died for a moment.

You look around... It's just the same open field of grass that you've been walking for the whole day.

You look forward.
The open field concaves down, and you see across the field a massive crack in the ground blocking your way.
On the other side of the crack the grass fields are much more vibrant in color. The grass is greener on the other side!

Cheese: [Woo!]

Cheese enters ghost form and floats over the canyon towards the other side.
In the middle of flight he changes direction and comes back.

Cheese: [Wow, the canyon is way wider than it looks. It's kind of scary to float across.]

You look to the sides and find that the canyon stretches from horizon to horizon.
It's strange, since this canyon is not found on the map that Lucid gave you.

canyon escape.title: Fields
canyon escape.text:
You somehow destroy the giant mass of vines.
Whirring sounds fade away.

You haul Cheese up the canyon and return to the camp.

Cheese: [O...Oof...]

You pull out a circular metal sheet from his leg and patch him up.

canyon escape 2.title: Fields
canyon escape 2.text:
Cheese: [Aight... I think I can walk now... Let's get the hell out of here.]

You climb out of the canyon safely.

field 2.title: Fields
field 2.text:
You continue across the fields, looking for a way across the canyon.

Cheese: [Blue skies, green fields, soft winds, this is the joy of travel... Cobby used to say.]

You've been travelling north for a day now, but the canyon to your right does not seem to end.

Cheese: [At least there aren't monsters around the canyon.]

You hear a sound.

field 3.title: Fields
field 3.text:
You continue walking along the canyon.
It seems to be thinning a little...

Cheese: [Hey look, a bridge!]

You look toward the canyon and see a rope hanging across the canyon.
You approach the rope and see that the rope was tied firmly to a tree all the way by the woods.
You find a pile of logs near the knot. It looks like someone is trying to build a bridge.

opt.text: Set up camp and wait for someone to come
Cross the canyon using the rope
Just cross the canyon using the rope

field 4-1 2.title: Fields
field 4-1 2.text:
You are at camp.

Cheese: [Are we gonna live here? Let's just use the rope to cross.]

opt.text: Just cross the canyon using the rope

field 4-3.title: Fields
field 4-3.text:
You scout around to try to find someone.
You hear a sound.

field 4-2.title: Fields
field 4-2.text:
You give all your baggage to Cheese.

Cheese: [Woo!]

Cheese floats across.
You hug the rope and start slithering toward the other side.

field 5.title: Fields
field 5.text:
You try not to look down into the abyss.
Once in a while Cheese would shake the rope from the other side to scare you.
Your hands are sweating, but the other side is still far away...

field 6.title: Fields
field 6.text:
You make it to the other side and drop on the ground, trembling. Whew!
The rope was tied to a wooden pole, next to the start of a dirt path.

Cheese: [If we follow this dirt path we'll run into people. Ya wanna get up now?]

field 7.title: Fields
field 7.text:
You follow the dirt path.

You see a group of wooden buildings near a forest.
You enter the village.

village.title: Woodcutters' Village
village.text:
You are at a lumber mill.
There are bulky lumberjacks dressed in leather and furs walking around. %?t1

opt.text: Make a conversation with one of the villagers
Make a conversation with one of the villagers

village rest.title: Woodcutters' Village
village rest.text: You roll out your sleeping bag and rest by the perimeter of the village.

village talk.title: Woodcutters' Village
village talk.text:
Villager: [What? Yea, the crevice. It just cracks like that after a big earthquake. Happens.]

Cheese: [Happens?]

Village: [Happens.]

village talk 2.title: Woodcutters' Village
village talk 2.text: Villager: [We sell wood to Jericho. Ever heard of it? Place's full of god forsaken metal heads. They look nothin like us.]

jericho woods.title: Woods
jericho woods.text:
You reach the Jericho River near the village.
You walk along the river for a while and realize that you haven't run into any monsters since leaving the canyon area.

Cheese: [Life is so much simpler without monsters around. Hey look, another tree cutter.]

You see a person wearing fur armor just standing by a tree near the river, staring at you.

Stranger: [Howdy, got a minute?]

You hear bowstrings being drawn around you.

jericho woods 2.title: Woods
jericho woods 2.text: Cheese: [What the hell was that? Why did they attack us?]

opt.text: Looks like they wanted our gold.

jericho woods 3.title: Woods
jericho woods 3.text:
Cheese: [What? They wanted to kill us for gold? That doesn't make sense.]

You bury their corpses and continue along the river.
Once in a while you see wooden buildings and people wearing leather and strange metal objects on their face.
But every time you try to talk to them, they would just tell you to go away in a rude way.

Cheese: [You know, it's like the closer we get to Jericho, the more metal we find on these people's faces. Maybe that's why they act so cold? The metal in their faces must have drove them insane.]

jericho woods 4.title: Woods
jericho woods 4.text:
You continue walking along the river.

Cheese: [Wow, they have stone tiles all along the river! We could take these and build a house!]

Several people walking by point at Cheese and chuckle.

Cheese: [What are you looking at? You gonna take my money too?]

They all hurry along.

You continue along the river.
The river splits into two, and there is a small mountain in the middle with a tall brick tower at the top.
According to the map, Jericho lies directly behind the tower.

jericho woods 5.title: Woods
jericho woods 5.text:
You try to find a way to cross the river, but see no bridges around.
You see a funny metal boat floating on the river.
It's got a funny spinning metal on the top and two people riding on it.

Cheese: [Hey! nice boat! Can we hitch a ride to the island?]

They look at Cheese but don't respond.

Cheese: [What the hell is wrong with these metalheads? they mute or something?]

Cheese starts throwing rocks at them.

Cheese: [Hey! Morons! I'm talking to you!]

jericho woods 6-2.title: Woods
jericho woods 6-2.text:
Cheese hits one of them with his stone.

Cheese: [Did that hurt? Huh? Say that it did and I'll stop throwing!]

They yell something at Cheese and chuck a metal ball at him.
Red flashes leak out from the metal ball, unleashing a monster!

jericho woods 6-1.title: Woods
jericho woods 6-1.text:
You tell Cheese that it's probably not a good idea to make a scene in an unfamiliar place.
You pass the tower and just continue down the river.

You hear a waterfall.
Soon you emerge from the treeline and find yourself at the top of a cliff, with a grand view of a massive open field of dirt.

Cheese: [Dry dirt, all the way to the horizon. Is that Jericho?]

In the distance you see what must be Jericho, a cluster of tall towers and spinning metals in the middle of the dirt field.
Above the sky you see dozens and dozens of strange floating constructs, way larger than bloodquito or any monster you know.

jericho woods 7.title: Woods
jericho woods 7.text:
You look around the cliff trying to find a way down, but you don't find any.
Above the air you see flying constructs pass you by towards the city.

Cheese: [Hey! Can we get a ride?]

Cheese throws a rock at them but they spit on him from above.
Furious, Cheese turns into a ghost and floats toward them, but he is nowhere as fast as the flying construct.
The passengers seem panicked by Cheese's ghost form.
They fly away even faster than before.

jericho woods 8.title: Woods
jericho woods 8.text:
You continue looking for a way down the cliff, but there doesn't seem to be any around.
You give up looking and set up camp.

Once in a while people would walk by your camp and look at you and Cheese in a funny way.

jericho woods 9.title: Woods
jericho woods 9.text:
You are taking a nap when you hear a bustling sound.
You look up and see a thief stealing your entire baggage.
You wake Cheese up.
The thief draws a knife.

jericho woods 10.title: Woods
jericho woods 10.text:
You leave the thief lying on the ground and proceed to search for the way down.
Three people in full plate armor approach you.

Guard: [Sir, can we ask you some questions?]

Cheese: [No. Why?]

Guard: [Wait, is that a corpse? Take them down!]

jericho woods 11.title: Woods
jericho woods 11.text:
Guard: [Oof, c-call backup!]
The guards try to run away.

jericho woods 12.title: Woods
jericho woods 12.text:
You hurry out of the crime scene and continue looking for a way down.

Cheese: [I don't think Jericho's gonna be friendly to us now... You know, I don't remember the last time being in a friendly settlement.]

You are starting to experience less foot and air traffic.
The cliff seems to curve inward around Jericho, and you see the cliff continue all the way to your left in the distance.

You finally give up and decide to go back to the river and hitch a ride down.

jericho woods 13.title: Air boat rental
jericho woods 13.text:
You travel all the way back to the river.
You track where those flying constructs are coming from and find a giant wooden building in the woods near the river.
There are people outside and some of them seem to recognize Cheese and point at him while saying something.

Cheese: [What?]

They hurry inside, and you follow them in.

Merchant: [Ah, uh, hello, do you have business with us?]

opt.text: We wish to go down the cliff to Jericho

jericho woods 14.title: Air boat rental
jericho woods 14.text: Merchant: [Well... Do you have any gold? It's quite expensive. It's 10 gold.]

opt.text: Coerce the merchant for a free ride
Ask the merchant for a free ride

jericho woods 14-2.title: Air boat rental
jericho woods 14-2.text:
Merchant: [Of course, yes, free air boat, over here please.]

The merchant guides you to an air boat.
It's a brass boat with many circular machine parts and a glider canopy at the top.
You grab his assistant and carry him on board with you and Cheese.

Merchant: [Uh, I'd never let my customers fall using any of my boats! But if you must take him, please leave him at the arrivals.]

The merchant pulls down a lever and the boat departs toward Jericho.

Cheese: [You know, at this point we can't go any worse. We should just rob Jericho for super weapons and return to Ant Hill and beat the shit out of the spiders.]
You see the assistant quietly trembles with fear.

jericho woods 14-3.title: Air boat rental
jericho woods 14-3.text:
Merchant: [Of course, yes, free air boat, over here please.]

The merchant guides you to an air boat.
It's a brass boat with many circular machine parts and a glider canopy at the top. You and Cheese hop in.

The merchant pulls down a lever and the boat departs toward Jericho.
The boat slowly rise to the skies.
As the boat flies past the waterfall and over the dirt plains, you start to panic from being so far off the ground.

Cheese: [You know, that merchant was actually a nice person, giving us free ride and all. I was starting to get frustrated from everyone looking at us funny.]

Suddenly, the air boat stops flying and you start to crash down towards the ground.
You see Cheese enter ghost form and float away.
You look back down at the ground, which getting closer every second. Well shit.

jericho woods 14-1.title: Air boat rental
jericho woods 14-1.text:
Merchant: [Very good, sir! Over here please.]

The merchant guides you to an air boat.
It's a brass boat with many circular machine parts and a glider canopy at the top. You and Cheese hop in.

The merchant pulls down a lever and the boat departs toward Jericho.
The boat slowly rise to the skies.
As the boat flies past the waterfall and over the dirt plains, you start to panic from being so far off the ground.

Cheese: [Wow, this is awesome!]

You see that he is clutching on his amulet nervously with his trembling hand.

jericho woods 15.title: Jericho
jericho woods 15.text:
The boat flies over the massive dirt plains.
Jericho, with all its strange metal structures, seems like a place from the wildest dreams.
You feel the cold breeze pass you by and throw up over the boat.
You look around and see that Cheese had entered ghost form long ago, and is trying to catch up in the distance.
You throw up again.

You enter Jericho.
The strange looking buildings are much stranger close up, with spinning metal blades and circular machinery everywhere.
The boat bumps into the side of a tower and slowly fall onto the flat roof of a building.

The boat drops onto the roof with a thud.
You jump off the boat and throw up one last time.
In the distance you see a shimmering purple dot, which must be Cheese trying to catch up to you.

jericho woods 16-2.title: Jericho
jericho woods 16-2.text:
Suddenly, you hear busy footsteps everywhere around you.
You see guards pop out from behind the crates around you.

Guard: [Bloodied weapon. It's the killer, go go!]

jericho woods 16-3.title: Jericho
jericho woods 16-3.text:
Assistant: [Please, can you let me go now?]

Suddenly, you hear busy footsteps everywhere around you.
You see guards pop out from behind the crates around you.
The assistant runs away toward the guards.

Assistant: [HELP! They abducted me!]

jericho woods 16-1.title: Jericho
jericho woods 16-1.text:
You sit down and wait patiently for Cheese to arrive.

Cheese: [Hey. I accidentally used my amulet. My bad.]

You climb down a ladder on the side of the building and enter the streets of Jericho.

jericho jail.title: Jericho Jail
jericho jail.text:
The guards hold you down and cuff you.

Guard: [Uh, what the?]

You see Cheese float away in ghost form.

Guard: [Can't do anything about that... Let's just throw this one in prison.]

You are severely beaten by the guards and dragged into a large building complex under the cliff.
They take away your weapons and money.
They throw you in a large brass cell.

opt.to: >dropAll>>moneySet>0>>removeAll>>force item>prisoner clothes>>force item>prisoner pants>>force item>pickaxe>@jericho jail 2

jericho jail 2.title: Jericho Quarry
jericho jail 2.text:
They move you to some quarry by the cliffs and cuff your legs to a heavy metal ball.

There are about ten other prisoners in the quarry.

Prisoner: [Take this pick. You see those two barrels? You need to fill those with copper.]

Fat prisoner: [No, you need to fill all three barrels over there.]

Short prisoner: [Fill mine while you're at it too, rookie!]

jericho jail 3-2.title: Jericho Quarry
jericho jail 3-2.text:
Fat Prisoner: [HAHAHAHA! I like this guy! Keep fighting rookie, you're gonna mine for me from now on!]

The prisoners put you down on the ground and continue to beat you.
You see a purple dot behind the prisoners... It's getting bigger.

Guard: [What the hell is that?]

You are suddenly engulfed in a fiery explosion.
You pass out...

jericho jail 3-1.title: Jericho Quarry
jericho jail 3-1.text:
Prisoner: [Oof... Okay, you're a tough one. Hey guys, come over here, this rookie wants to fight!]

More prisoners emerge from all around you and approach you.
The guards also gather around, but with no intention to stop the fight.

Above the crowd of people gathering around you, you notice a purple light in the sky. It is getting bigger.

Prisoner: [Alright rookie, time for a good beating!]

A good number of the crowd rushes toward you!
Suddenly, you are blinded by strong light and deafened by a loud sound of explosion.. You lose consciousness.

jericho jail 3-3.title: Jericho Quarry
jericho jail 3-3.text:
Another prisoner: [Hey, fill mine too!]

Scarred prisoner: [You see that barrel by the post? Fill that. To the rim.]

Some prisoners just straight out give you their pickaxes.

Limping grandpa prisoner: [You know what to do. Mine's the one on the far right.]

Guard: [What the hell?]

You look where the guard is looking at and see a purple ghost in the sky.
It materializes on the second floor of the guard tower... and it's Cheese.
Cheese starts casting fireball.

Guard: [Is that... a wizard?]

The fireball strikes the guard, and the resulting explosion engulfs everyone nearby.

Guard: [We are under attack!]

Another guard: [Who? Where?]

Another fireball hits the dormitory building.
People run out of the building screaming, on fire.
You break your foot chain with your pickaxe and run towards the exit with the other prisoners.
Just as you make it to the gates, you are engulfed by a fiery explosion...

jericho jail 4.title: Jericho Jail
jericho jail 4.text:
You wake up in the prison hospital.
The place is packed with badly burnt prisoners and guards.
A guard comes in and escorts you out.
You look carefully, and it's Cheese in guard uniform.

Cheese: [You all looked the same, so I just fireballed everyone. Here, wear this.]

jericho jail 5.title: Jericho Jail
jericho jail 5.text:
Cheese talks to a guard outside the hospital.

Cheese: [Hey, I gotta take this prisoner to the city. Help me out.]

The guard points at a wagon.

Guard: [Ask one of them to give you a ride.]

You and Cheese hitch a ride on a wagon to Jericho.

Cheese: [Easy stuff. You can thank me later.]

They shove you into the trunk of the wagon. It is pitch black.

Half an hour later, you hear people talking in the front seat.

Guard: [To the jail, right?]

Cheese: [Nah, just drop me off here.]

Cheese takes you out of the trunk into the streets of Jericho.

jericho 1.title: Jericho
jericho 1.text:
You take a look around you.

Buildings taller than trees all around you block the skies.
Metal pipes connect floors and rooms of buildings, unleashing steam and smoke at their ends.

Strange orange light on a pole decorate the streets, where people wearing fancy leather jackets and wearing funny metal and glass shapes on their faces roam.
They are either completely apathetic toward you or points and laughs at Cheese's dirty hair.

Once in a while you see someone driving a ridiculously large wheel with a wagon attached behind.
In the distance you see a large brass statue of a posing man.

The entire city is saturated with screeching metal sounds and smell of sulfur.

opt.text: Look for the Guild of Retrieval

jericho 2.title: Jericho
jericho 2.text:
You ask around for the Guild of Retrieval.

One of the residents point to one of the tall towers in the city.

Cheese: [Lucid lives in one of those tower? Wow, Lucid is a big boy.]

You enter the building.
You are astonished at how smooth, clean, and light brown the inside of the building is.
A fat man wearing full leather armor stops you.

Guild Door Guard: [Wait, what's your business here?]

jericho 3.title: Jericho
jericho 3.text:
Guild Door Guard: [Ok, just stay here. I'll tell Lucid.]

He goes and talks to one of the people in the building.

Cheese: [Did you just tell a person to tell Lucid that we're here?]

Guild Door Guard: [Yes. If he knows you, he'll be here.]

Cheese: [How would he know that it's me if I haven't even told you my name?]

Guild Door Guard: [Oh, he'd know.]

Five minutes later, you see Lucid and Pemmi descend down from above in a small cage.
The cage door opens and they greet you with open arms.

Pemmi: [Hey! You're here!]

Lucid: [Very good, friends. This is a pleasant surprise.]

jericho 4.title: Jericho
jericho 4.text:
You, Pemmi, Lucid, and Cheese walk down the streets of Jericho.

Cheese: [Ooo, what's that?]

Lucid: [That is a bicycle. You sit and pump a set of pistons with your legs, and the machine moves you and your luggage with ease.]

Cheese: [What's that? Looks dangerous.]

Lucid: [That is a propeller. Converts wind into moving parts.]

Cheese: [What are those hideous things that people are wearing?]

Lucid: [Those are glasses. They let you see better.]

You arrive at a fancy tavern with multiple pipes coming out of its windows.

Cheese: [Wow, metal chairs!]

People look at Cheese.

Pemmi: [Cheese, please shut up in here.]

Lucid: [This is an inn where you can stay. You should get cleaned and dressed like a Jericho resident as soon as possible.]

Cheese: [Like Jericho-nians? Looks weird as hell.]

Lucid: [Cheese, your purpose here is to get help for Ant Hill, isn't it? It's going to be very helpful if you adjust to Jericho's ways first.]

Cheese: [Actually, that's his business. I'm just here for the tour.]

Lucid: [...]

jericho camp.title: Jericho
jericho camp.text:
You are at the Jericho Inn.

Your room is on the second floor, with a window providing a nice view of the streets of Jericho.
The sound of screeching metal from the streets and people talking in the lobby can be heard in your room without much effort.

jericho first talk.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho first talk.text:
Guild Door Guard: [You again? Just go up to suite 303.]

Cheese: [Donno how.]

The guard shoves you and Cheese into the brass cage in the middle of the room and presses some buttons.
You are carried upward into a lobby on the third floor.

Lucid: [Oh.]

Pemmi: [Hey.]

Cheese: [What are you doing? Oh, mother of god, poor Cobby!]

Lucid: [Please excuse us. You've come to talk about the Ant Hill situation, yes? Please wait in that room, I'll be with you shortly.]

You and Cheese walk in to Jericho's office and wait.
A moment later, Lucid and Pemmi joins you.

jericho talk.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho talk.text: Lucid: [So. What is your plan now?]

opt.text: Gather weapons and artifacts for Ant Hill
Gather knowledge about the horned spiders
Go buy the crate of muskets

jericho talk job.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho talk job.text:
Lucid: [The inn is free for you to stay in. Also, take this.]

Lucid hands you 40g.

Lucid: [You could take jobs from the guild if you want. The guild can provide you gold and many useful items. I'll let them know downstairs that you are looking for jobs.]

jericho talk lucid.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho talk lucid.text:
Lucid: [I work here in the Guild of Retrieval. I had taken an offer from the guild to explore the frontier settlements to look for some artifact. I had known that the frontier was a dangerous place, but I never imagined that it could be that bad.]

Cheese: [It ain't so bad, if you're tough.]

Lucid: [No... The spiders, they had the strength and wits to overtake humanity's place at the top of the food chain. It shocked me.]

Lucid: [I wasn't successful in accomplishing my mission, so I may be down in the frontier again. If I do, I'll take that opportunity to help you again.]

Cheese: [What mission.]

Lucid: [The Guild of Retrieval trade in artifacts. I'm part of the artifact retrieval team.]

jericho talk gather.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho talk gather.text:
Lucid: [Frankly, there are very few ways to get people to travel all the way to Ant Hill to save some people they don't know exists... And not just anyone, you need many people who know how to fight against ferocious monsters.
The only group I can think of is the infamous Adventurers Guild... ]

Pemmi: [Infamous?]

Lucid: [They've had their share of scandals. They've been accused of thievery, murder, and demon worship, among others.]

Cheese: [Oh, fucking great. That's great, dude.]

Lucid: [I'm just brainstorming available options. The Adventurers Guild may help you defeat the spiders, even with low compensation, if you can promise them artifacts.]

Pemmi: [But we don't have artifacts... Oh, the feral caves!]

Lucid: [If Cheese shows them his amulet's power, they may even agree to help you for free. The Guild of Adventurers are just as artifact hungry as our guild.]

Cheese: [No... Are you kidding me? Show my amulet to bloody murderers?]

opt.text: We'll come back to this later
This is a good idea, let's get started
Why not ask the Guild of Retrieval?

jericho talk gather 2.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho talk gather 2.text: Lucid: [The Guild of Retrieval simply aren't equipped to face hordes of monsters. Most operations take place in the vicinity of Jericho. The Adventurers' Guild, however, is more focused on, well, adventures. But they too, look for artifacts like the Guild of Retrieval. You could say they are competing with us.]

jericho talk spiders.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho talk spiders.text: Lucid: [When I accepted the contract to the frontier, I was given access to the great library to study the frontier. I remember there being a book of menageries. Maybe that book could help you.]

opt.text: We'll come back to this later
This is a good idea, let's get started

jericho talk weapons.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho talk weapons.text: Lucid: [In Jericho, we have powerful weapons called muskets. I did not take it with me in my travels as it was too heavy and limited in ammunition. But if you can somehow bring these to Ant Hill and equip them with it, you will have good chance at destroying the spiders.]

opt.text: We'll come back to this later
This is a good idea, let's get started

jericho get know.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho get know.text:
Lucid: [I'm afraid that I can't take the book out of the library for you. I recommend that you take up on a job with the guild and ask for library access up above.]

Pemmi: [Up?]

Lucid: [Yes, sweetie, the library is on an airship. We'll need to take an air boat to get there. When you have time, go downstairs and ask for a job. When they give you a list of available contracts, pick one that requires library access.]

jericho get know 2.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho get know 2.text: Lucid: [When you have time, go downstairs and ask for a contract. When you've gained some trust with the guild, ask them for a library card.]

jericho get weapon.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho get weapon.text:
Lucid: [Alright then, let's visit the supply district.]

Lucid guides you through the city to the supply district, where buildings are rather wide and the air is replaced with steam and smoke.

Smith: [Howdy.]

Lucid: [Hello. We're looking to buy muskets. As much muskets and ammunition as possible for 4 people to carry around.]

Smith: [Alright. That'll be around 2000g.]

Lucid: [We don't have that much money right now. Is there a cheaper option?]

Smith: [Unless you make your own muskets, no.]

Lucid: [Well... I don't see how we can make 2000g on our own. We'll have to think of something else.]

jericho get help.title: Adventurers Guild
jericho get help.text:
Cheese: [The moment they find out about this amulet, they're gonna kill me over it like those bandits in the woods. I don't trust these Jericho-nese.]

Lucid: [They can't just kill you in the city. Also, those could be just rumors, Cheese. We'll see how it turns out.]

Lucid leads you to the Adventurers Guild, right across the street.

Recipient: [Hello, how may I help you?]

Lucid: [We're looking to get help fighting a colony of horned spiders... in a frontier settlement. Can your guild provide help?]

Recipient: [Oh... Let me talk to my boss. I'll be right back.]

A few minutes later, a big man with scars on his face shows up.

Bigs: [Hello. My name is Bigs. I'm the Guild Lieutenant. You said you have a monster infestation problem?]

Lucid: [Yes. An entire colony of horned spiders. Can you help?]

Bigs: [We haven't done mercenary work for a while. How many spiders are we talking about? A colony? We're going to ask for at least 5000g.]

Cheese: [Oh, great mother of god!]

Lucid: [We have knowledge of a deep ancient mine with powerful artifacts.]

Bigs: [Oh?]

Lucid stares at Cheese.

Cheese: [...]

opt.text: Force Cheese to show his power

jericho get help 2.title: Adventurers Guild
jericho get help 2.text:
You reach for Cheese's amulet.
Cheese tries to run but you grab him.
Just as you are about to reach the amulet, Cheese presses it and turns into a purple phantom.

Bigs: [Incredible!]

Cheese stuns you and floats out the window.

Lucid: [We had found a few similar artifacts. The mine was infested with... cannibal undead, so we did not delve in any further. The mine is located deep inside one of the horned spider nests.]

Bigs: [And... this place is at the frontier? Hmm...]

Bigs stands, rubbing his beard for quite a while.

Bigs: [You're Lucid from the guild across, right? I'll visit you and let you know.]

You leave the guild.

Pemmi: [Well, I hope they're up to the challenge.]

Lucid: [He sounded pretty excited about it. Shall we return?]

jericho tavern.title: Brass Dishes
jericho tavern.text:
You, Cheese, and Pemmi walk into a Jericho tavern named Brass Dishes.

Pemmi: [It's nice here, don't you think?]

Waiter: [What would you like to have?]

You are given a menu.

opt.text: A leek soup with cheese and asparagus

jericho tavern 2.title: Brass Dishes
jericho tavern 2.text:
You eat your %?temp.
It tastes alright.

Local: [Hey, you're the guy who turns into ghosts!]

Cheese: [The what? you believe in ghosts? get outta here.]

Another local: [Yea, he's the guy who destroyed the guards! I'm sure!]

Local: [Look mate, you need to get in the tourney, you're gonna be rich, I swear!]

Cheese: [What tourney and how much rich?]

Local: [It's the tournament at New Jericho, winner gets a grand prize of 3000 gold!! And, and! Don't forget me, mate, throw me a coin!]

The entire tavern starts cheering for Cheese.
Cheese gathers mana and juggles a fireball with a big smile.

Cheese: [Aight, I'm the ghost wizard, ya got me. If I win that tourney or whatever, I'll buy ya'll drinks for a week.]

Everyone goes wild, chanting 'Ghost Wizard'.

By the end of the day, you've had more drinks than you can remember, all for free.

jericho guild.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho guild.text:
You are at the Guild of Retrieval lobby.

The fat door guard makes a conversation with you, complaining about the state of Guild of Retrieval.

jericho guild register.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho guild register.text:
Recipient: [Please fill out these forms.]

Cheese: [Huh?]

Recipient: [Can you write your name here?]

Cheese: [I know how to read.]

Recipient: [Huh?]

Cheese: [We only know how to read.]

Recipient: [Oh... Let me get Lucid real quick.]

Lucid comes down, and has a long conversation with the recipient.

Recipient: [Alright. This way, please.]

jericho guild 2.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho guild 2.text: Manager: [Welcome. Would you like to see the contract listing?]

jericho quest kill.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest kill.text: Manager: [This is a quest to fetch an artifact in the possession of outlaws. There are four of them out by the perimeter in a shack under the northern cliffs.]

jericho quest kill 2.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest kill 2.text:
You depart on the mission.

Since you and Cheese didn't trust the air boats, you walk to the northern cliffs over an hour.

Cheese: [Hey look, thugs chilling by a brass shack.]

opt.to: >encounter>jericho outlaws>@jericho quest kill defeat>@jericho quest kill done

jericho quest kill defeat.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest kill defeat.text:
You collapse.

...

Cheese: [Wake up... You need to stop relying on me to save you every time.]

You notice that your entire life savings is gone.

jericho quest kill 2-1.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest kill 2-1.text:
You approach them and say hello.
They hello you back.
You have a conversation about how bad the streets of Jericho smells.

opt.text: These guys are pretty nice, let's go back

jericho quest kill 2-1 2.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest kill 2-1 2.text: They look at each other for a second then pulls out their swords.

jericho quest kill done.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest kill done.text:
You take the amulet and return to the guild.

Manager: [Very good! Here's your reward.]

You receive 20g.

jericho quest find.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest find.text:
Manager: [We've lost a crate full of shock inducing rings.]

Cheese: [Why do you have a crate full of shocking rings?]

Manager: [We trade all kinds of artifacts in this guild.]

Cheese: [What particular use does shock rings have?]

Manager: [I don't know... maybe it's a part of some machine?]

Cheese: [Can we read up about it in the great library?]

Manager: [No... that's not part of this job at all. The crate was lost in the supply district, right before being sent here. The crate is a bit illegal, so try to avoid asking the guards about it.]

jericho quest find 2.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest find 2.text:
You find the warehouse quartermaster in the supply district.

Quartermaster: [I've been transporting doodads for 3 guilds for the last 20 years, but never have lost a package like this. It's a shame.]

Pemmi: [Do you have any clues as to where it could be?]

Quartermaster: [I don't, sorry.]

jericho tavern find.title: Brass Dishes
jericho tavern find.text:
You, Cheese, and Pemmi walk into a Jericho tavern named Brass Dishes.

Pemmi: [I love Brass Dishes, we should come whenever we have the chance.]

Waiter: [What would you like to have?]

You are given a menu.

opt.text: Stir fried young grass roots and clams

jericho tavern find 2.title: Brass Dishes
jericho tavern find 2.text:
You enjoy your %?temp and talk about the whereabouts of the crate.

Waiter: [Oh, the crate? it's back here. The quartermaster always leaves his stuff in here.]

You retrieve the crate.

jericho quest find done.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest find done.text:
Manager: [Well done. We used to have this one person take this contract every time I put it out... I guess he was just fetching it from the bar all this time. I think we need a new quartermaster. What the hell was he doing with that crate in the bar, anyways?]

The manager gives you 20g.

jericho quest haggle.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest haggle.text:
Manager: [There's a guy that we've been trying to buy an artifact from. He's a wizard that lives in a tower by the waterfall. We can offer up to 100g, but he's asking for 200. Take this 100g, you can keep any margins you make.]

Cheese: [This... doesn't seem like a fair contract.]

Manager: [If that's what you think, just take another contract. Remember that all we care about is the artifact, however you get it is none of our business.]

jericho quest haggle 2.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest haggle 2.text:
Cheese: [I'm out of this one. I'm, uh, supposed to have a spellcasting session with Lucid today.]

You and Pemmi take the air boat to the tower.
Pemmi throws up twice, and you only throw up once during the flight.

Pemmi: [I should've stayed back with Cheese... ugh!]

You arrive at the tower at the top of the mountain.
You knock, but no one answers.
You hear sound inside the tower.
You continue knocking...
Finally, an old man wearing a blue robe and hat answers.

Tower Wizard: [Helloo?]

You tell him you're here to buy the artifact.

Tower Wizard: [Of course, yes, yes, come in!]

Tower Wizard: [Tea? It is very good, yes, good!]

The wizard leave you in the fancy living room and leaves to fetch some tea.

Pemmi: [Did you see him looking at me? I don't trust him at all...]

Tower Wizard: [I'm back! yes, ooh, here's some tea, would you mind telling me how you like the view?]

Pemmi: [No, we're quite busy. We'd appreciate it if we can talk about the artifact.]

Tower Wizard: [hehehe, of course, my darling, why, I may even consider giving it to you as a present! Just stay a while and give company to a poor lonely old man.]

jericho quest haggle 3.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest haggle 3.text:
Tower Wizard: [Have you seen the large statue in Jericho? It is the statue of a legendary man who was said to unite all tribes on the continent and found Jericho.]

The old wizard continues to talk about things like the wonders of spells over steam engines.
You pretend to listen.
You and Pemmi do not even touch the tea.

Tower Wizard: [Why, aren't you all thirsty? This tea is really good, you must try it!]

Pemmi: [We... we come from a region where we only eat or drink after business is done.]

Tower Wizard: [Oh, and where's that?]

Pemmi: [It's Stone Henge, some frontier settlement far away. Please stop touching me with your foot.]

Tower Wizard: [Ah, excuse me, it's an old habit. Yes, Stone Henge, I've been there. Nice place, sadly infested with horned spiders.]

Pemmi: [You've been to the frontier? You know about the spiders?]

Tower Wizard: [Of course, dear. I've gone hunting for ancient ruins far and wide. I've explored distant lands and triumphed over many monstrosities!]

The old wizard goes on and on about his exploits.

Pemmi: [Uh... right. Like you said, Stone Henge and Ant Hill are both infested with those spiders. Is there any way you can help us?]

Tower Wizard: [Oh, sweetheart, you are so pretty when you plead like that, oh yes. But then, sadly, no. I can't help you. Those horned spiders are one of the most terrifying things I've seen.]

Pemmi: [We've killed a couple before, they can be defeated if we gather some people!]

Tower Wizard: [Oh, young and naive girl, you have no idea what you're talking about. Does killing a few soldiers befall a kingdom? Killing a few spiders doesn't mean anything to them.]

Pemmi: [A kingdom?]

Tower Wizard: [Oh, sometimes I just talk too much. Here, take this artifact. Dear, listen to this old man and stay in Jericho where the grass is greener.]

The wizard refuses to talk any more about the spiders.
You leave the tower.

jericho quest haggle done.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest haggle done.text:
Manager: [He gave it to you for free? Wow. Honestly, I expected you to kill him and take it from him. But this is even better. What was it, coercion or temptation? Actually, don't tell me.]

You receive an additional 20g for contract completion.

jericho quest research.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest research.text:
Manager: [This is a research contract. We usually hand these out only to internal members, but... You are all registered under Lucid's name, so you are able to take this contract. You will join a research team in researching what caused the ground to fissure by the fields west of a woodcutters' village. There is a possibility that the fissure was man-made, which implies artifact involvement.]

Pemmi: [Will Lucid join us?]

Manager: [He's got a lot of work to do right now, but you should definitely ask him.]

Cheese: [Can we get library access? We need some background knowledge, you know?]

Manager: [Of course. Let me get you all a library card.]

You gain library access.

Manager: [Here you go. You need to be waiting in the lobby by tomorrow, or the team will leave without you. Good luck!]

jericho quest research 2.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest research 2.text: Lucid: [Very good, you got the library access. If the fissure research is tomorrow, we should check out the library today. Let's move.]

jericho quest research 3.title: New Jericho
jericho quest research 3.text:
Lucid takes you to a air boat rental in the middle of the dirt plains away from Jericho.

Lucid and Pemmi takes an air boat, and you and Cheese take another air boat toward New Jericho.
As soon as the boat lifts, Cheese panics and enters ghost form.

You fly as high as the clouds.
In the clouds, you see a giant balloon airship bigger than any building you've seen on Jericho.
You land on a pad under the airship

Lucid: [Welcome to New Jericho. Where's Cheese? Oh.]

You enter the airship through a hatch on the ceiling and wait for Cheese to arrive.

Cheese: [Sup.]

Lucid: [Welcome to New Jericho. Let's get to the library.]

You leave the fancy arrivals hall decorated with various statues and paintings.
You follow Lucid through several narrow halls and enter the library.
It is a long room laced with labeled levers along the walls.

Lucid: [Alright, we'll each do our own studies then meet up here when we're done.]

jericho library.title: New Jericho
jericho library.text:
You walk up and down the library.
There's no chairs and barely any people...

jericho library fiction.title: New Jericho
jericho library fiction.text:
You pull the lever labeled 'Fiction'.
The wall with the lever flips inward, and you find yourself in a small room full of books.
You sit on a chair and start reading a book about the story of a chef who ran around Jericho killing pipe cleaners.

jericho library manuals.title: New Jericho
jericho library manuals.text:
You pull the lever labeled 'Manuals'.
The wall with the lever flips inward, and you find yourself in a small room full of manuals.

Merchant: [Let me know if you want to buy any of them.]

jericho library reports.title: New Jericho
jericho library reports.text:
You pull the lever labeled 'Reports'.
The wall with the lever flips inward, and you find yourself in a small room full of books.
You see Pemmi sitting on a chair reading a book.

Pemmi: [Here, the book of menageries that Lucid was talking about. 'When the brave settlers left Jericho to create the frontier settlements 300 years ago, they have faced many monstrosities that no men have encountered before.']

Pemmi: ['At the time of writing, new monstrosities such as the horned spiders have been reported in the frontier.']

Pemmi: [Let's see... 'It's only been a few years since the horned spiders have emerged to prey upon mankind, but they are reported to have a deep understanding of the human specie.' This isn't really helpful... They don't seem to have much understanding of the horned spiders.]

jericho library done.title: New Jericho
jericho library done.text:
Lucid: [Hey. Found what you need?]

Pemmi: [Apparently the horned spiders are pretty new. There's barely any information on them.]

Lucid: [I see... Let's go upstairs and tour around New Jericho before leaving.]

new jericho.title: New Jericho
new jericho.text:
You are at New Jericho main hall.
The huge room is fully lit with bright orange spell lights as well as sunlight from the windows on the side walls.
There are three rows of long fancy tables and countless chairs, only a few occupied by fancy looking aristocrats.
There are open stairs leading up to the second and third floor on the far end.

new jericho bar.title: New Jericho
new jericho bar.text:
You, Cheese, Pemmi, and Lucid take a sit at the fancy New Jericho bar.

Cheese: [Golden lights and carpet floors, nice.]

Waiter: [What would you like to have?]

You are given a menu.

opt.text: Maggots and cheese with a cup of fermented honey
Red tick popcorn with a cup of female urine

new jericho bar 2.title: New Jericho
new jericho bar 2.text:
That was pretty bad... You leave the rest on the table.

Pemmi: [You know Lucid is paying for all this, right? Don't order something that you're not going to finish...]

opt.text: Ask Lucid to help pay 5g to watch the tournament

new jericho arena defeat.title: Colosseum
new jericho arena defeat.text:
You, Cheese, Pemmi were all eliminated.
Some bulky guy wins the grand prize.

new jericho arena.title: Colosseum
new jericho arena.text: Coach: [New participants? good stuff, we were running out of slaves. The rules here are simple, you kill or defeat your enemies in a row, you get the money. Also, no explosions.]

opt.to: >encounter>arena 1>@new jericho arena defeat>>encounter>arena 2>@new jericho arena defeat>>encounter>arena 3>@new jericho arena defeat>>encounter>arena 4>@new jericho arena defeat>>moneyAdd>2433>@new jericho arena win

new jericho arena win.title: Colosseum
new jericho arena win.text:
Broadcaster: [Uh... You won! Good job..?]

The broadcaster and the arena master looks a bit confused for some reason.
The crowd cheers, and you receive 2433 gold after tax.
You return to the waiting room.

Pemmi: [Yess! You are certainly better than any hunters I've seen! Cobby would've been so proud of you!]

Lucid: [You did very, very good! No one in Jericho or New Jericho will dare to pick a fight with you.]

Cheese: [What kind of moronic duel outlaws fireball? This is complete bullshit. I could've won easy.]

You return to the main hall.

new jericho colosseum 2.title: Colosseum
new jericho colosseum 2.text:
You enter the colossum.
You watch two people hack and slash at each other with various weaponry.
One of them finally dies in the bloodbath.
Some healers jump in, revive and heal the dead guy, and drag him off.

Cheese: [Looks pretty boring. I bet I could've beat anyone here.]

Lucid: [You're not allowed to use explosive magic here, Cheese.]

Cheese: [Then this isn't a fight. This is a child's play.]

Some bulky guy wins the grand prize.

jericho quest research depart.title: Jericho
jericho quest research depart.text:
The research team arrives in the lobby.

Manager: [Here are the rest of your members.]

Team Lead: [Thank you. Nice to meet you all. Shall we go?]

The team lead takes you, Lucid, Pemmi, Cheese, and the rest of the research team to an air boat ride to the cliffs.

Team Lead: [Are you alright? Not a fan of air boats, huh? That's fine. We're going to be walking from now on, since machines don't work outside Jericho. Let's go.]

Cheese: [Legwork or air boat... life is pain.]

jericho quest research canyon.title: Fields
jericho quest research canyon.text:
You travel with the research team for a week and arrive at the woodcutters' village.

Team Lead: [Hello, can we stay here for a while?]

Villager: [Who are you?]

Team Lead: [We're a research team from Jericho. We can pay for food and shelter.]

Villager: [You're here to see the crevice? How long?]

Team Lead: [We don't know yet, but maybe for a week. We'll pay 70 gold. 10 gold per day.]

Villager: [All seven of you? alright. You can stay in that big building. You need some food now?]

Team Lead: [No, we're going to take a look at the canyon before dinner, thank you.]

Villager: [Alright. Just note that the canyon bridge is not done. We can't get it made because it's too dangerous.]

Team Lead: [What kind of danger?]

Villager: [I dunno. Two of my friends went missing in the canyon.]

jericho quest research canyon 2.title: Fields
jericho quest research canyon 2.text:
You and the team walks over to the canyon.

Team Lead: [Let's go down on to that surface below. Ready the spell lights.]

They tie a rope to a pole and climb down, one by one.
You follow right behind Lucid, and Cheese floats around the team lead.

Team Lead: [Uh, I don't know how you're doing that, but could you scout ahead for us?]

Cheese: [Sure.]

Cheese floats down.
You start hearing weird whirring sounds from below.

Cheese: [Huh?]

Something hits Cheese from the darkness below.
Cheese's ghost body is ripped somewhat.
He tries to float toward the cliff.

Team Lead: [Light, shoot the light!]

The team shoots several spell lights toward the abyss.
There are countless amounts of masses of vines down below, slowly creeping toward your group.

jericho quest research canyon 3.title: Fields
jericho quest research canyon 3.text:
Team Lead: [Up! UP!!]

You find Cheese near the cliff.

Lucid: [I got Cheese, just go up.]

You climb up the rope along with all other panicked research team.
Some of the surviving vine things shoot metal fragments at your group.
Several members get hit and fall into the abyss.

You get to the top and see Lucid climb up behind you, with ghosted Cheese on his back.

Team Lead: [What on earth was that? Vines shooting metals?]

Lucid: [We should get back to Jericho. There is no way we can save those that fell.]

Team Lead: [...You are right. We are ill equipped for this. We are going back.]

You return to Jericho.

research chasm.title: Abyss
research chasm.text:
...

You feel your face against warm sand.
You open your eyes.
It's pitch black.
You turn your head up and see the white crevice of daylight far, far above you. Is this the end?
Every bone in your body aches.

You walk the pitch black darkness hopelessly for a bit before giving up and lie down on the warm sands.

How much time has passed? The white crevice has faded into pitch black abyss.

research chasm 2.title: Abyss
research chasm 2.text:
You yell.
Whatever attention you gather seems like the least of your problems now.

But there are no responses whatsoever.

...

You start singing a steady chant in the darkness to alleviate your boredom and sense of doom.

research chasm 3.title: Abyss
research chasm 3.text:
You hear footsteps on the sand.
You stop singing.
You hear a soft thud.
You freeze in place. What monstrosity could take residence in this abyss?

Suddenly, a familiar yet strange voice reaches out to you from the darkness.

???: [Take the amulet.]

research chasm 4.title: Abyss
research chasm 4.text:
No response.
You walk toward where the sound came from and find what feels like an amulet on the ground.

You pick it up and press on it.

again jericho quest research canyon.title: Fields
again jericho quest research canyon.text:
It feels like you've died for a moment.

Lucid: [Is something wrong?]

You look around... There's nothing wrong.
You continue following the research team to the canyon

Your group finally reach the canyon.

Team Lead: [Let's go down on to that surface below. Ready the spell lights.]

They tie a rope to a pole and climb down, one by one.
You follow right behind Lucid, and Cheese floats around the team lead.]

Team Lead: [Nice! I don't know how you're doing that, but could you scout ahead for us?]

Cheese: [Sure.]

Cheese floats down.
You start hearing weird whirring sounds from below.

Cheese: [Huh?]

Something hits Cheese from the darkness below.
Cheese's ghost body is ripped somewhat.
He tries to float toward the cliff.

Team Lead: [Light, shoot the light!]

The team shoots several spell lights toward the abyss.
There are countless amounts of masses of vines down below, slowly creeping toward your group.

jericho quest research done.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho quest research done.text:
Manager: [Oh, yes, I heard about what happened. Research sometimes turn into a bloodbath like this. It's just a part of the job at this point.
Here's your 20g.]

Cheese: [Well... mission accomplished, I guess.]

jericho guild bigs.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho guild bigs.text:
You return to the guild lobby and see Bigs.

Bigs: [Howdy, our guild decided to invest in this venture. We're sending 8 of our finest members equipped with muskets to deal with the horned spiders.]

Pemmi: [Oh, yes!]

Bigs: [We're going to get prepared soon, just let us know when you are going back to the frontier.]

jericho get weapons.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho get weapons.text:
Lucid: [Alright, we got the money, let's find the smith.]

You go over to the supply district and buy two dozens of muskets and a barrel of ammunition.

Lucid: [That should be enough to arm the veteran hunters of Ant Hill or Stone Henge.]

jericho depart.title: Jericho
jericho depart.text:
You decide to leave Jericho and tell everyone.

---

At the streets in front of the inn you see Cheese, Pemmi, and Lucid, all packed up and ready to go.

jericho depart 1-1.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho depart 1-1.text: Lucid: [We got enough muskets to equip the veteran hunters of Ant Hill or Stone Henge. It's a shame that we couldn't get the adventurers. Let's return now.]

jericho depart 1-2.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho depart 1-2.text: Lucid: [We got the adventurers. They'll be of great help in defeating the horned spiders. But it's a shame that we couldn't get muskets to arm the hunters. Let's return now.]

jericho depart 1-3.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho depart 1-3.text: Lucid: [We got enough muskets to equip the hunters. We also got Bigs and his adventurers to help us fight the spiders. Let's return to the frontier and free the people from the spiders!]

jericho depart 1-4.title: Guild of Retrieval
jericho depart 1-4.text:
Pemmi: [Alright, now... We didn't get the weaponry nor the help from Jericho as we had hoped. But we gotta do what we gotta do for our people.]

Lucid: [Yes. We'll see what we can do.]
